# tgo

Package main provides the TGo command.

The command passes a source directory to the compiler. The compiler writes and checks generated Go beside its TGo source.

Matching file names preserve Go's test and platform selection rules. Ordinary Go, TGo inputs, assets, and dependencies stay at their existing paths.

Language rules belong to the compiler. The command chooses the source directory; it does not change the meaning of a program.
